verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export feature. Portability is only implied: deployments come from the user's own GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket repository, so source code stays with the user. Account data is reachable through a REST API with a published OpenAPI description, and the CLI can retrieve logs and replicate the deployment environment locally. One community comment reports successfully leaving Vercel for a self-hosted alternative. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export feature, open-format exports of logs, analytics, environment variables and project configuration, offboarding or migration documentation, and independent hands-on evidence of a complete data export.
